definitions.explanation: A warm-blooded vertebrate with feathers and wings. Also used as a general term for poultry.
In food contexts, often refers to chicken meat.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいます→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧{鳥|とり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: There's a small bird, isn't there?
There's a bird in the tree.
In the morning, a bird had come outside the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いろいろな→色々：02352_iroiro⟧{鳥|とり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{見|み}ていて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: There are various birds in this park, and it's fun to watch them.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べます→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{晩|ばん}ごはん→晩ご飯：02940_bangohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鳥|とり}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}→焼き鳥：04952_yakitori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{鳥|とり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{買|か}います→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Chicken is cheaper than fish, so I often buy it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鳥|とり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant's chicken is very delicious, so I always come to buy it.

notes:
鳥 is the general word for 'bird' but in food contexts often specifically means chicken (as in ⟦焼き鳥→焼き鳥：04952_yakitori⟧, yakitori—grilled chicken skewers). For the specific animal 'chicken,' ⟦鶏→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧ (niwatori) is used.

Related:
- ⟦鳥肉→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧ (toriniku, chicken meat)
- ⟦小鳥→小鳥：01590_kotori⟧ (kotori, small bird).
